title: Be Concerned About
subtitle: be concerned about = 關心；擔心；對……感到憂慮；在意
description: be concerned about = 關心；擔心；對……感到憂慮；在意

words.note: 最直接、最常見的近義表達之一，通常表示擔心某件事可能出問題。
words.example: Parents often worry about their children's safety online.

exercises.original: Parents are often concerned about how much time their children spend online.
exercises.zh: 家長經常擔心子女花太多時間上網。
exercises.upgrade: worry about · 擔心；為……憂慮

options.explanation: worry about = 擔心。句子明確表示家長對子女上網時間可能帶來負面影響感到憂慮。
be interested in = 對……有興趣。家長可能對這個議題有興趣，但原句重點是擔憂，不是好奇。
be aware of = 知道。知道子女上網很多，不等於因此擔心。
care for = 照顧。語法和意思都不合；這裡不是說照顧「上網時間」。
think about = 思考。只表示想到，不包含焦慮。
be concerned with = 涉及、與……有關。這裡說的是情緒上的擔心，不是主題範圍。

exercises.original: She is concerned about whether the company can meet the deadline.
exercises.zh: 她擔心公司能否如期完成。
exercises.upgrade: worry about · 擔心；為……憂慮

options.explanation: care about = 在意。可以表示她重視期限，但不能充分表達「怕做不到」的憂慮。
worry about = 擔心。whether the company can meet the deadline 明顯是不確定結果帶來的憂慮。
be aware of = 知道。知道期限存在不等於擔心能否做到。
think about = 考慮。沒有負面情緒。
be interested in = 有興趣。語意太弱，也方向不同。
be concerned with = 涉及。不是情緒反應。

exercises.original: You should not be concerned about a small mistake that is easy to correct.
exercises.zh: 你不應為一個容易改正的小錯誤而擔心。
exercises.upgrade: worry about · 擔心；為……憂慮

options.explanation: panic about = 因……恐慌。比原句強得多；小錯誤不值得「恐慌」。
worry about = 擔心。語氣自然，程度和原句相符。
be interested in = 對……有興趣。不是負面情緒。
be aware of = 知道。和「不需要擔心」不是同一意思。
care for = 照顧／喜歡。不能這樣搭配 mistake。
be concerned with = 涉及。不是情緒上的擔憂。

words.note: 和 worry about 很接近，但更強調某人當下的擔心狀態。
words.example: She is worried about the possibility of further delays.

exercises.original: She is concerned about the possibility of further delays.
exercises.zh: 她擔心可能會再有延誤。
exercises.upgrade: is worried about · 對……感到擔心

options.explanation: is aware of = 知道。知道有延誤可能性，不等於為此感到不安。
is worried about = 感到擔心。possible further delays 是很典型的憂慮對象。
is interested in = 有興趣。和負面期待不符。
cares for = 照顧。語意錯誤。
is concerned with = 涉及。不能表示她的感受。
thinks about = 想到／考慮。沒有擔心的成分。

exercises.original: The doctor is concerned about the patient's high temperature.
exercises.zh: 醫生對病人的高燒感到擔心。
exercises.upgrade: is worried about · 對……感到擔心

options.explanation: is interested in = 有興趣。醫生不是覺得高燒「有趣」。
is worried about = 擔心。高燒可能表示健康風險，因此自然。
is aware of = 知道。太中性。
thinks about = 思考。沒有醫療憂慮的意思。
cares for = 照顧。醫生可以 care for the patient，但不能說 care for the high temperature。
is concerned with = 涉及。不是感情狀態。

exercises.original: Residents are concerned about the effect of the roadworks on local businesses.
exercises.zh: 居民擔心道路工程對本地商戶的影響。
exercises.upgrade: are worried about · 對……感到擔心

options.explanation: are worried about = 感到擔心。道路工程可能傷害生意，帶有清楚的負面後果。
are interested in = 有興趣。過於中性。
are aware of = 知道。沒有擔心意味。
care for = 照顧。不能這樣搭配 effect。
think about = 思考。並不必然焦慮。
are concerned with = 涉及。不是情緒上的憂慮。

words.note: 比一般 worried 更強，常帶有較明顯的緊張或焦慮感。
words.example: Many students are anxious about the final examination.

exercises.original: Many students are concerned about the final examination and have been sleeping badly.
exercises.zh: 很多學生都對期末考試感到焦慮，而且睡不好。
exercises.upgrade: are anxious about · 對……感到焦慮；憂慮

options.explanation: are interested in = 有興趣。和 sleeping badly 所表現出的焦慮不符。
are anxious about = 焦慮。睡不好顯示擔心程度較強，最貼切。
are aware of = 知道。太中性。
care about = 在意。學生當然在意考試，但原句還有明顯焦慮反應。
think about = 想到。沒有強烈感情。
are concerned with = 涉及。語意不合。

exercises.original: He is concerned about speaking in front of a large audience tomorrow.
exercises.zh: 他對明天要在大批觀眾面前發言感到焦慮。
exercises.upgrade: is anxious about · 對……感到焦慮；憂慮

options.explanation: is aware of = 知道。不是情緒。
is anxious about = 對未來事情感到焦慮。公開演講是典型 anxiety 語境。
cares for = 照顧／喜歡。不能表示焦慮。
is interested in = 有興趣。和緊張感不同。
is concerned with = 涉及。不是個人情緒。
thinks about = 想到。程度太弱。

exercises.original: She has been concerned about the interview all week.
exercises.zh: 她整個星期都為面試感到焦慮。
exercises.upgrade: has been anxious about · 對……感到焦慮；憂慮

options.explanation: has been anxious about = 一直感到焦慮。all week 表示這種緊張持續了一段時間。
has been interested in = 一直有興趣。不能表達壓力。
has been aware of = 一直知道。不是情緒。
has cared for = 照顧過。語意錯誤。
has been concerned with = 一直涉及。不是面試焦慮。
has thought about = 想過。可能是真的，但比原句弱很多。

words.note: 表示心裡不太放心、不舒服或有疑慮，通常比 anxious 稍弱。
words.example: Some residents are uneasy about the proposed development.

exercises.original: Some residents are concerned about the proposed development but have not decided whether to oppose it.
exercises.zh: 一些居民對擬議發展感到不安，但仍未決定是否反對。
exercises.upgrade: are uneasy about · 對……感到不安

options.explanation: panic = 恐慌。原句只是有疑慮、尚未決定，沒有那麼強烈。
uneasy = 不安、不太放心。正好符合有疑慮但未到強烈反對或恐慌的程度。
interested = 有興趣。沒有負面感情。
aware = 知道。知道 proposal 不等於對它不安。
care for = 照顧／喜歡。語意不合。
concerned with = 涉及。不是情緒。

exercises.original: I am concerned about giving the company access to so much personal data.
exercises.zh: 我對讓公司取得這麼多個人資料感到不安。
exercises.upgrade: am uneasy about · 對……感到不安

options.explanation: interested = 有興趣。和私隱疑慮不同。
uneasy = 不放心。分享大量個人資料帶來不安感，最自然。
aware = 知道。太中性。
care for = 照顧／喜歡。不能表示疑慮。
concerned with = 涉及。不是感情。
think about = 想到。沒有不安意味。

exercises.original: Several board members are concerned about the speed of the proposed changes.
exercises.zh: 數名董事對擬議改變的速度感到不安。
exercises.upgrade: are uneasy about · 對……感到不安

options.explanation: uneasy = 不安、有疑慮。board members 對變動速度不放心，非常貼切。
interested = 有興趣。沒有負面評價。
aware = 知道。不是疑慮。
care for = 照顧。不能搭配 speed。
concerned with = 涉及。不是個人態度。
think about = 思考。程度不足。

words.note: 表示某件事令某人持續感到困擾、憂慮或不安。
words.example: She was deeply troubled by the rise in youth homelessness.

exercises.original: She is deeply concerned about the rise in youth homelessness.
exercises.zh: 青年無家可歸情況上升令她深感憂慮。
exercises.upgrade: is deeply troubled by · 因……而深感困擾

options.explanation: interested = 有興趣。社會問題帶來的是憂慮，不只是興趣。
troubled by = 因……深感困擾。deeply 和嚴重社會問題令這個表達非常合適。
aware = 知道。沒有感情強度。
concerned with = 涉及。不是她的情緒。
cares for = 照顧。語意不合。
thinks about = 思考。太弱。

exercises.original: The doctor was concerned about the number of patients missing follow-up appointments.
exercises.zh: 醫生對很多病人缺席覆診感到困擾。
exercises.upgrade: was troubled by · 因……而困擾

options.explanation: troubled by = 困擾。病人持續缺席覆診會令醫生擔憂和不安。
interested = 有興趣。不是專業上的擔心。
aware = 知道。沒有表達問題令他困擾。
cared for = 照顧。doctor cares for patients，不是 cares for the number。
concerned with = 涉及。不是情緒。
thought about = 想過。太中性。

exercises.original: He has long been concerned about the decline in local wildlife.
exercises.zh: 他長期以來一直對本地野生動物減少深感憂慮。
exercises.upgrade: has been troubled by · 因……而困擾

options.explanation: interested = 有興趣。不能表達長期憂慮。
troubled by = 深感困擾。has long 顯示這是一個持續讓他掛心的問題。
aware = 知道。太中性。
cared for = 照顧。和 decline 搭配不自然。
concerned with = 涉及。不是感情。
thought about = 想過。程度太弱。

words.note: 較正式，表示對未來可能發生的事情感到擔心或不安。
words.example: Employees are apprehensive about the planned restructuring.

exercises.original: Employees are concerned about the planned restructuring because some roles may disappear.
exercises.zh: 員工對計劃中的重組感到憂慮，因為部分職位可能消失。
exercises.upgrade: are apprehensive about · 對……感到憂慮；有戒心

options.explanation: apprehensive = 對將來可能發生的負面事情感到憂慮。職位可能消失，正是典型語境。
interested = 有興趣。無法表達失去職位的擔憂。
aware = 知道。太中性。
care for = 照顧／喜歡。語意不合。
concerned with = 涉及。不是員工的感受。
excited = 興奮。和可能失去工作方向相反。

exercises.original: She is concerned about moving to a city where she knows nobody.
exercises.zh: 她對搬到一個完全不認識人的城市感到憂慮。
exercises.upgrade: is apprehensive about · 對……感到憂慮；有戒心

options.explanation: excited = 興奮。可能同時存在，但原句明顯是擔心未知環境。
apprehensive = 對即將發生的事情感到憂慮。搬到陌生城市完全符合。
aware = 知道。不是感受。
care for = 照顧／喜歡。無關。
concerned with = 涉及。語意錯。
interested = 有興趣。太中性。

exercises.original: Investors are concerned about what may happen after the sudden leadership change.
exercises.zh: 投資者對突然更換領導層後可能發生的情況感到憂慮。
exercises.upgrade: are apprehensive about · 對……感到憂慮；有戒心

options.explanation: interested = 有興趣。不能表達投資風險帶來的不安。
apprehensive = 對未來不確定結果感到憂慮。很符合投資者面對突發改變的情境。
aware = 知道。過於中性。
care for = 照顧。無關。
concerned with = 涉及。不是情緒。
pleased = 高興。和擔憂相反。

words.note: 當 be concerned about 的意思是「重視、關心」而不是「焦慮」時，care about 很自然。
words.example: The organization genuinely cares about the welfare of its staff.

exercises.original: The organization is deeply concerned about the welfare of its staff.
exercises.zh: 這個機構非常關心員工的福祉。
exercises.upgrade: cares about · 關心；在意

options.explanation: worry about = 擔心。可能存在，但原句更像重視員工福祉，而不是焦慮某件壞事。
care about = 在意、關心。welfare 是價值和重視的對象，最自然。
aware = 知道。知道員工福祉問題不等於真正重視。
concerned with = 涉及。機構的工作可能涉及 welfare，但原句說的是態度。
think about = 思考。沒有重視意味。
interested = 有興趣。比 care about 弱，而且可能只是好奇。

exercises.original: Good employers are concerned about how their decisions affect employees.
exercises.zh: 好的僱主會在意自己的決定如何影響員工。
exercises.upgrade: care about · 關心；在意

options.explanation: aware = 知道。知道影響存在，不等於在意後果。
care about = 在意。這裡強調僱主重視員工受到的影響。
interested = 有興趣。不能表達道德或責任上的重視。
concerned with = 涉及。不是態度。
think about = 考慮。比 care about 弱。
care for = 照顧。可以 care for employees，但不能直接表達「在意 decisions affect employees」這個抽象意思。

exercises.original: She is concerned about environmental issues and tries to reduce waste.
exercises.zh: 她關心環境議題，並嘗試減少浪費。
exercises.upgrade: cares about · 關心；在意

options.explanation: care about = 關心。她還採取行動減少浪費，顯示不只是知道，而是真正在意。
panic about = 恐慌。程度太強。
aware = 知道。不能解釋她為甚麼採取行動。
concerned with = 涉及。不是個人價值取向。
think about = 想到。程度不足。
interested in = 有興趣。可以有興趣而不採取行動，和 care about 不同。

words.note: 表示在作決定或行動時，有意識地考慮某件事，語氣較正式。
words.example: Managers should be mindful of the pressure placed on junior staff.

exercises.original: Managers should be concerned about the pressure placed on junior staff when setting deadlines.
exercises.zh: 管理人員在設定期限時應顧及初級員工承受的壓力。
exercises.upgrade: be mindful of · 留意；顧及；注意

options.explanation: be mindful of = 顧及、留意。這裡重點是在作決定時把員工壓力納入考慮。
panic about = 恐慌。管理人員不需要恐慌。
interested = 有興趣。太弱，沒有責任感。
concerned with = 涉及。不是「作決定時要顧及」。
aware = 知道。知道還不夠，句子要求把它納入決策。
care for = 照顧。語法上不適合 pressure。

exercises.original: When planning the event, we need to be concerned about accessibility.
exercises.zh: 策劃活動時，我們需要顧及無障礙需要。
exercises.upgrade: be mindful of · 留意；顧及；注意

options.explanation: interested = 有興趣。活動規劃需要實際顧及 accessibility，不只是有興趣。
mindful of = 留意並顧及。規劃語境非常自然。
panic about = 恐慌。程度不合。
concerned with = 涉及。可以說 planning is concerned with accessibility，但不等於「我們要顧及」。
think about = 想到。比 mindful of 的責任意味弱。
care for = 照顧。不能這樣搭配 accessibility。

exercises.original: Teachers should be concerned about differences in students' learning needs.
exercises.zh: 老師應留意學生在學習需要上的差異。
exercises.upgrade: be mindful of · 留意；顧及；注意

options.explanation: panic = 恐慌。完全不必要。
mindful of = 留意並顧及。老師在教學時要考慮不同需要，最精確。
interested = 有興趣。太弱。
concerned with = 涉及。不是教師應有的態度。
care for = 照顧。可以 care for students，但不是 care for differences。
think about = 思考。沒有「顧及」的意味。

words.note: 強調主動注意某個人的需要、某個問題或某種變化。
words.example: Good teachers are attentive to changes in students' behaviour.

exercises.original: Good teachers are concerned about changes in students' behaviour.
exercises.zh: 好的老師會留意學生行為上的變化。
exercises.upgrade: are attentive to · 關注；留意

options.explanation: attentive to = 主動留意。學生行為變化需要老師持續觀察，最自然。
panic = 恐慌。過度。
interested = 有興趣。沒有專業關注意味。
concerned with = 涉及。不是態度。
care for = 照顧。不是「留意變化」。
aware = 知道。比 attentive to 被動。

exercises.original: Nurses must be concerned about small changes in a patient's condition.
exercises.zh: 護士必須留意病人情況的細微變化。
exercises.upgrade: be attentive to · 關注；留意

options.explanation: care for = 照顧。護士會照顧病人，但原句重點是察覺細微變化。
attentive to = 留意、注意。small changes 需要仔細觀察，非常貼切。
panic = 恐慌。不是專業應對。
interested = 有興趣。太弱。
concerned with = 涉及。不是主動注意。
think about = 思考。不能表達持續監察。

exercises.original: The company says it is concerned about customer feedback.
exercises.zh: 公司表示它會關注顧客意見。
exercises.upgrade: is attentive to · 關注；留意

options.explanation: attentive to = 重視並留意。customer feedback 是需要持續監察和回應的資訊。
panic = 恐慌。明顯過強。
interested = 有興趣。可能只是覺得有趣，不等於認真處理。
concerned with = 涉及。可以表示公司業務涉及 feedback，但不是態度。
aware = 知道。知道 feedback 存在不等於關注。
care for = 照顧／喜歡。搭配不自然。

words.note: 當 be concerned about 表示對某議題、人的發展或情況有持續關注時可用。
words.example: She has always taken an interest in local environmental issues.

exercises.original: She has always been concerned about local environmental issues.
exercises.zh: 她一直關心本地環境議題。
exercises.upgrade: has taken an interest in · 關心；對……有興趣

options.explanation: take an interest in = 持續關心。適合表示長期關注某個公共議題。
panic = 恐慌。環保關注不一定是恐慌。
aware = 知道。太被動。
concerned with = 涉及。不是個人持續關心。
care for = 照顧。不能搭配 issues。
worry about = 擔心。比 take an interest in 更負面，原句可能只是長期關注。

exercises.original: He became concerned about youth sports after his children joined a local club.
exercises.zh: 子女加入本地球會後，他開始關心青少年體育。
exercises.upgrade: took an interest in · 關心；對……有興趣

options.explanation: panic = 恐慌。沒有負面事件。
take an interest in = 開始關心／感興趣。子女加入球會後產生持續關注，很自然。
became aware of = 開始知道。沒有主動關注意味。
care for = 照顧。不能這樣搭配 sports。
concerned with = 涉及。不是個人興趣。
worry about = 一直擔心。原句沒有焦慮線索。

exercises.original: The new manager is concerned about staff development and regularly discusses training opportunities.
exercises.zh: 新經理很關心員工發展，並經常討論培訓機會。
exercises.upgrade: takes an interest in · 關心；對……有興趣

options.explanation: take an interest in = 關心。經常討論培訓機會顯示持續主動關注。
panic = 恐慌。完全不合。
aware = 只是知道。和 regularly discusses 不符。
concerned with = 涉及。可以描述職務範圍，但不是態度。
care for = 照顧。不能自然說 care for staff development。
worry about = 擔心。staff development 在這裡是正面關注，不是焦慮。

words.note: 表示某件事佔據很多注意力，常常帶有過度掛心或難以停止思考的意味。
words.example: He became preoccupied with the possibility of losing his job.

exercises.original: He has become so concerned about losing his job that he can hardly concentrate on anything else.
exercises.zh: 他一直掛心可能失去工作，以致幾乎無法專注其他事情。
exercises.upgrade: is preoccupied with · 一直掛心；滿腦子想着

options.explanation: interested = 有興趣。和失業焦慮不符。
preoccupied with = 滿腦子想着。can hardly concentrate on anything else 正好說明這件事佔據大量注意力。
aware = 知道。太弱。
concerned with = 涉及。不是心理狀態。
care for = 照顧。無關。
occasionally = 偶爾想。和 cannot concentrate on anything else 相反。

exercises.original: She is constantly concerned about what other people think of her.
exercises.zh: 她總是掛心別人怎樣看她。
exercises.upgrade: is preoccupied with · 一直掛心；滿腦子想着

options.explanation: preoccupied with = 一直掛心。constantly 顯示這件事持續佔據她的思想。
interested = 有興趣。太輕。
aware = 知道。不是反覆在意。
concerned with = 涉及。不是情緒。
care for = 照顧。無關。
rarely = 很少想。和 constantly 相反。

exercises.original: He became concerned about the company's financial problems to the point that he stopped sleeping properly.
exercises.zh: 他一直掛心公司的財務問題，甚至開始睡不好。
exercises.upgrade: became preoccupied with · 一直掛心；滿腦子想着

options.explanation: aware = 知道。不能解釋睡眠受影響。
preoccupied with = 一直掛心。問題嚴重到影響睡眠，程度很合適。
interested = 有興趣。語氣不對。
concerned with = 涉及。不是心理壓力。
care for = 照顧。無關。
briefly = 短暫想過。和 stopped sleeping properly 完全不符。

words.meaning: 為……煩惱得睡不着；十分擔心
words.note: 常見口語表達，表示因某事非常擔心或反覆煩惱。
words.example: Don't lose sleep over a mistake that can easily be fixed.

exercises.original: You should not be so concerned about a minor error that can easily be fixed.
exercises.zh: 你不應為一個很容易改正的小錯誤煩惱得睡不着。
exercises.upgrade: lose sleep over · 為……煩惱得睡不着；十分擔心

options.explanation: lose sleep over = 為……非常煩惱。句子有 so concerned 和 minor error，這個口語表達非常自然。
interested = 有興趣。不是煩惱。
aware = 知道。沒有焦慮感。
concerned with = 涉及。意思錯。
care for = 照顧／喜歡。無關。
take an interest in = 關注。程度和情緒都太弱。

exercises.original: She is far too concerned about what strangers think of her clothes.
exercises.zh: 她太過在意陌生人怎樣看她的衣着，甚至為此煩惱。
exercises.upgrade: loses sleep over · 為……煩惱得睡不着；十分擔心

options.explanation: aware = 知道。沒有過度在意意味。
lose sleep over = 過分煩惱。far too concerned 和這個口語誇張表達很匹配。
interested = 有興趣。太輕。
concerned with = 涉及。不是心理狀態。
care for = 喜歡／照顧。無關。
take an interest in = 關心。通常較中性，不表示過度焦慮。

exercises.original: There is no reason to be concerned about a problem that has already been solved.
exercises.zh: 一個已經解決的問題，沒有理由再為它煩惱。
exercises.upgrade: lose sleep over · 為……煩惱得睡不着；十分擔心

options.explanation: take an interest in = 關注。不是負面煩惱。
lose sleep over = 為……煩惱。已解決的問題不值得繼續擔心，語氣很自然。
aware = 知道。不是焦慮。
concerned with = 涉及。不是心理感受。
care for = 照顧／喜歡。無關。
interested = 有興趣。方向不同。

words.note: 較正式、較中性的表達，常見於工作、政策、醫療或公共討論。
words.example: Several experts have concerns about the long-term effects of the policy.

exercises.original: Several experts are concerned about the long-term effects of the policy.
exercises.zh: 數名專家對這項政策的長期影響有疑慮。
exercises.upgrade: have concerns about · 對……有疑慮；感到擔憂

options.explanation: have concerns about = 對……有疑慮。正式、中性，特別適合 experts / policy 語境。
interested = 有興趣。不能表達專業疑慮。
aware = 知道。沒有負面評估。
concerned with = 涉及。不是專家持有的態度。
care for = 照顧。無關。
think about = 思考。太中性。

exercises.original: The committee is concerned about whether the new system protects personal data adequately.
exercises.zh: 委員會對新系統是否充分保障個人資料有疑慮。
exercises.upgrade: has concerns about · 對……有疑慮；感到擔憂

options.explanation: have concerns about = 有疑慮。committee 對制度是否足夠安全提出正式保留，非常自然。
interested = 有興趣。沒有批判性疑慮。
aware = 知道。太弱。
concerned with = 涉及。可以說 committee is concerned with data protection，意思會變成其工作範圍。
care for = 照顧。語意不合。
think about = 思考。沒有 concern 的負面評估。

exercises.original: Some doctors are concerned about prescribing the drug to very young children.
exercises.zh: 一些醫生對把這種藥處方給年幼兒童有疑慮。
exercises.upgrade: have concerns about · 對……有疑慮；感到擔憂

options.explanation: have concerns about = 有疑慮。醫療決策中用這個正式表達非常自然，表示有安全或適切性上的保留。
interested = 有興趣。不能表達醫療風險疑慮。
aware = 知道。太中性。
concerned with = 涉及。意思會變成「工作範圍涉及處方」。
care for = 照顧。不能這樣搭配 prescribing。
think about = 考慮。沒有疑慮意味。 --- End of teaching material

falseSynonyms.zh: 有興趣不等於關心／擔心 be interested in 主要表示想了解或覺得有趣；不一定包含重視、責任感或擔憂。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can be interested in climate change as a topic. You may be concerned about it because you think its consequences are serious.

falseSynonyms.zh: 想到不等於憂慮 think about 只是把某件事放在腦中考慮，不一定帶有感情。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I can think about next year's budget without being concerned about it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 知道不等於關心 be aware of 表示知道某件事存在；知道不代表你在意或擔心。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You may be aware of a problem without being concerned about it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 害怕不完全等於擔心 be afraid of 通常表示恐懼某人、某物或某種結果，比一般 concern 更強，也更像 fear。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is concerned about the exam results. She is afraid of failing completely.

falseSynonyms.zh: 照顧／喜歡 不等於 care about care for 可以表示照顧某人，或在某些語境表示喜歡；care about 才表示「在意、關心」。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Nurses care for patients. Good nurses also care about their patients' well-being.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性不同 concern 可以是名詞或動詞；concerned 是形容詞／過去分詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON There is growing concern about safety. Residents are concerned about safety.

falseSynonyms.zh: 搭配不同 be concerned about 常表示擔心；be concerned with 常表示「涉及、與……有關」。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is concerned about the cost. The report is concerned with the cost of public transport.

falseSynonyms.zh: 恐慌比一般 concern 強得多 panic about 表示失去冷靜或極度害怕；be concerned about 通常沒有這麼強烈。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can be concerned about a delay without panicking about it.
